combat.guard_desc: Costs {mana} Mana. Block for 0.90s, reducing the next hit by 62%. During the first {window}s, a perfect parry reduces it by 92% and deals 28 Stability damage.
combat.move_arcane_rupture_desc: Deals arcane damage and burns away Mana.
combat.move_blood_feast_desc: Regenerates health and grants life steal.
combat.move_dark_ritual_desc: Empowers the enemy's damage and speed.
combat.move_defensive_shell_desc: Raises defense and reflects attack damage.
combat.move_devour_companion_desc: Maims your pet and heals the enemy.
combat.move_drain_life_desc: Steals health with a shadow strike.
combat.move_execution_desc: Deals massive damage to a badly wounded target.
combat.move_glacial_breath_desc: Deals damage and severely slows attacks.
combat.move_entangling_roots_desc: Deals damage and briefly roots you in place.
combat.move_flame_breath_desc: Scorches you and leaves a lingering burn.
combat.move_smoke_veil_desc: Blinds you while hastening the enemy.
combat.move_sunder_armor_desc: Smashes through armor and makes you vulnerable.
combat.move_withering_hex_desc: Curses you and amplifies incoming damage.
combat.move_war_cry_desc: Boosts the monster's damage and attack speed.
combat.move_earthshatter_desc: A crushing impact that deals heavy damage and stuns.
combat.move_grave_chill_desc: Slows your attacks and plants a delayed curse.
combat.move_soul_siphon_desc: Steals health while burning away Mana.
combat.move_shield_bash_desc: Deals damage and briefly locks your abilities.
combat.move_iron_bulwark_desc: Greatly raises defense and reflects attack damage.
combat.move_fan_of_knives_desc: A flurry of blades coated in lingering poison.
combat.move_shadowstep_desc: A brutal ambush that leaves you blinded.
combat.move_corrosive_bite_desc: Poisons you and makes subsequent attacks hurt more.
combat.move_parasitic_bloom_desc: Regenerates health beneath a hardened shell.
combat.move_meteor_desc: Deals massive fire damage and leaves a severe burn.
combat.move_temporal_lock_desc: Freezes ability recovery and severely slows initiative.
combat.move_savage_pounce_desc: A heavy leap that pins you in place.
combat.move_terrifying_roar_desc: Crushes initiative and leaves you vulnerable.
combat.poise_desc: The enemy's stability. Stability damage does not reduce Health: it empties this bar. At 0, the enemy's cast is interrupted, it is stunned for 1.6s, and it takes 25% more damage for 3.2s. Stability regenerates by 4 per second while the enemy is not casting.
combat.stance_aggressive_desc: Basic attacks deal 20% more damage, but you take 12% more damage. Each hit deals 6 Stability damage.
combat.stance_defensive_desc: Deal 16% less basic-attack damage and take 16% less damage. Guard has a wider perfect-parry window.
combat.stance_disruptive_desc: Basic attacks deal 22% less damage but inflict 16 Stability damage, rapidly breaking telegraphed casts.
combat.stance_precise_desc: Attack 10% slower and deal 5% less damage, but gain 18% critical chance. Each hit deals 7 Stability damage.
combat.watching_desc: Its next move will appear here.

class.assassin_desc: A stealthy and agile fighter, utilizing shadows and precision strikes.
class.bard_desc: Arcane performers who turn stories, rhythm, and presence into battlefield magic.
class.druid_desc: A guardian of nature, fights with magic and a loyal companion.
class.mage_desc: A scholar of arcane mysteries, wielding powerful spells.
class.warrior_desc: A master of arms and armor, relying on physical strength and battlefield tactics.

deity.aeloria_desc: Chaotic Good • Patron of liberation and brave chances.
deity.aurion_desc: Lawful Good • Defender of honorable law and sacred oaths.
deity.kharos_desc: Chaotic Evil • Exalts ruin, fury, and conquest.
deity.nyxara_desc: Neutral Evil • Trades in secrets, ambition, and forbidden power.
deity.oryn_desc: Lawful Neutral • Rewards discipline, preparation, and exacting craft.
deity.serapha_desc: Neutral Good • Guardian of mercy, shelter, and renewal.
deity.tharos_desc: True Neutral • Preserves the equilibrium of life and magic.
deity.vaelis_desc: Chaotic Neutral • Master of chance, roads, and sudden reversals.
deity.vhal_desc: Lawful Evil • Grants endurance to those who impose ruthless order.
effect.beastfrenzy: Beast Frenzy: {attack_pct}% pet attack and {attack_speed_pct}% pet attack speed for {duration}s
effect.bleed: Bleed: {damage_pct}% basic attack damage as damage over time

effect.clearcasting: Clearcasting: {reduction_pct}% mana costs of abilities for {duration}s
effect.cleave: Cleave: Deals {damage_pct}% damage to second target for {duration}s
effect.echostruck: Echo Struck: {reset_pct}% chance to reset all cooldowns on hit
effect.lifesteal: Lifesteal: Restores {percentage}% of damage dealt as health for {duration}s

effect.soullink: Soul Link: Redirects {damage_transfer_pct}% of damage to pet for {duration}s
effect.statboost: Stat Boost: Temporarily increases {stat} by {amount} for {duration}s
effect.taunt: Taunt: Forces enemies to attack pet for {duration}s
effect.thorns: Thorns: Reflects {damage_reflected_pct}% of incoming damage as physical damage for {duration}s

general.ability_pool_exhausted: Ability pool exhausted! +5 Max Mana instead.
general.action_points_desc: Action Points represent an increasing measure of progress. They never reset.
general.attack_desc: Determines the power of basic attacks and physical offensive effects. Higher Attack produces more damage against a target's Defense.
general.craft_desc: Craft a piece of equipment suitable for your level.
general.defeat_screen_body:
You have been defeated and are severely injured.

As a penalty, you have gained 5 action points.

You must use the Rest action to recover your health before you can continue playing.
general.defeat_screen_body_pvp:
You have been defeated in the duel and are severely injured.

You must use the Rest action to recover your health before you can continue playing.
general.defense_desc: Reduces incoming direct damage. Higher Defense makes each point of enemy Attack less effective.
general.duel_desc: Challenge an opponent to a duel.
general.errand_desc: Run a small errand for a local, with limited risks and rewards.
general.expedition_desc: Explore a nearby location, with moderate risks but a chance on greater rewards.
general.gold_desc: Gold is used to buy equipment and consumables.
general.grand_accommodation_desc: Fully recover health and mana. Permanently increase max health and mana by {min_bonus}-{max_bonus}.
general.health_desc: A combatant's life. Taking damage lowers Health; reaching 0 defeats that combatant. Health regeneration continues at 35% of its listed rate during combat.
general.hunt_combat_triggered: Combat encountered! Prepare before the fight.
general.hunt_no_loot: The hunt found no loot this time.
general.initiative_desc: Determines how quickly basic attacks occur. Higher Initiative means a shorter delay between attacks.
general.load_character_failed: Could not load character. The selected save may be invalid or incompatible.
general.mana_desc: The resource used to cast abilities, determined by your character and equipment. Mana carries between battles and regenerates during combat at 35% of its listed rate.
general.mutation_offer_body: The battle has awakened a supernatural change within you. Become a {mutation}?
general.name: Name
general.odyssey_desc: Embark on a grand adventure, packed with danger, but rich with rewards and priceless loot.
general.perk_pool_exhausted: Perk pool exhausted! +5 Max HP instead.
general.precombat_desc: Adjust equipment and choose up to 5 abilities and 5 consumables for this fight.
general.quest_desc: Embark on an adventure to earn gold and find new equipment.
general.rest_desc: Rest to recover health and mana. Options range from simple rest to grand accommodation.
general.rough_rest_desc: Recover between 40-{max_pct}% max health and mana.
general.study_desc: Study tomes and scrolls. Scales with Intelligence.
general.toast_train_nothing_new: Trained hard, but learned nothing new.
general.train_desc: Train hard to increase a random attribute.
general.xp_desc: XP increases your level. Gain more XP from Hunt, Quest, and Duel.
modal.remove_perk_text: Are you sure you want to remove this perk?
modal.sell_item_text: Are you sure you want to sell this item?
mutation.undead_effect: Immune to Poison and Freeze effects, but -4 Constitution.
mutation.vampire_effect: All attacks bleed for +15% damage, but you take +15% Fire damage.

pet.bat_desc: A nocturnal creature that disorients foes with its erratic movements.
pet.bear_desc: A massive and powerful guardian, shielding its allies with immense strength.
pet.crocodile_desc: An armored river predator with a bone-crushing bite and unrelenting patience.
pet.eagle_desc: A majestic and sharp-eyed raptor, soaring high to strike from above.
pet.fox_desc: A clever and nimble companion that harasses enemies with quick, unpredictable attacks.
pet.griffin_desc: A majestic beast with the body of a lion and wings of an eagle, ruling both earth and sky.
pet.hell_hound_desc: A demonic creature born of fire and shadow, burning anything it touches.
pet.hyena_desc: A cunning scavenger that laughs in the face of danger and overwhelms prey in packs.
pet.lizard_desc: A quick and cold-blooded companion that blends into its surroundings with ease.
pet.manticore_desc: A terrifying legendary beast with a lion's body, bat wings, and a venomous scorpion tail.
pet.owl_desc: A wise and nocturnal hunter with keen sight, striking silently in the darkness.
pet.pegasus_desc: A legendary winged horse that carries its master across any battlefield.
pet.puma_desc: A sleek and silent mountain stalker, pouncing on its prey with lightning reflexes.
pet.rat_desc: A scrappy and resourceful rodent, nimble enough to slip past any defence.
pet.raven_desc: A watchful black-feathered scout that blinds distracted enemies with sudden diving strikes.
pet.snake_desc: A venomous and elusive hunter, striking silently from the shadows.
pet.spider_desc: A patient predator that ensnares enemies in its web before closing in for the kill.
pet.three_headed_dog_desc: A fearsome guardian of the underworld with three ferocious heads.
pet.tiger_desc: A fearless apex predator of immense speed and devastating strikeforce.
pet.unicorn_desc: A pure and magical creature whose horn channels powerful healing energy.
pet.vulture_desc: A grim carrion bird that circles overhead, striking when prey is at its weakest.
pet.weasel_desc: A quick and cunning predator with sharp teeth, darting swiftly through even the tightest spaces.
pet.wolf_desc: A loyal and swift predator, hunting in perfect harmony with its master.
race.dragonborn_desc: Dragon-blooded warriors with imposing strength and natural resilience.
race.dwarf_desc: Sturdy and resilient dwellers of the deep mountains, master craftsmen and warriors.
race.elf_desc: Graceful and wise guardians of the ancient forests, skilled in magic and archery.
race.halfling_desc: Small, quick, and uncannily fortunate wanderers who survive danger through courage and cleverness.
race.human_desc: Versatile and ambitious builders of empires, adaptable to any path they choose.
race.orc_desc: Fierce and powerful warriors of the wild wastes, valuing strength and honor in battle.
specialization.grave_dirge_desc: Forbidden chords carry power from beyond the veil.
specialization.iron_body_desc: Discipline makes flesh as steadfast as armor.
specialization.nightblade_desc: Strike before the target sees the blade.
specialization.open_hand_desc: Perfect direct technique turns the body into a weapon.
specialization.paladin_desc: A radiant champion sustained by conviction.
specialization.phantom_desc: A patient killer who appears at the fatal instant.
specialization.shadow_step_desc: Flow through openings before an enemy can react.
specialization.silver_ballad_desc: A restorative melody that refuses despair.
specialization.spirit_fist_desc: Channel inner energy through every movement.
specialization.templar_desc: An armored bulwark trained to hold any line.
specialization.venomhand_desc: Poisoned arrows and darts cripple foes from a safe angle.
specialization.war_chant_desc: Driving percussion turns courage into force.
specialization.warden_desc: An enduring protector of people and wild places.
specialization.wild_rhythm_desc: Unpredictable tempo keeps every foe off balance.
